study_note: Single-seed exploratory 14-million-decision Humanoid Walk base-v1 G4 ten-head run whose sole learning-axis change from the q10 min_all anchor is the outer policy-learning Q reduction from min_all to mean_all; both outer and inner target reductions and the inner actor reduction remain min_all over ten heads, with entropy-augmented critic targets, a trainable cloned inner critic, automatic outer and inner entropy coefficients, and no actor-loss percentile scaling. Observational value-equivalence diagnostics run every 1,000 outer updates with four Monte Carlo samples and do not alter the learning objective. Make no confidence, significance, or confirmatory claims.
